description: A Global Feature-Rich Network Dataset of Cities and Dashboard for Comprehensive Urban Analyses is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Winston Yap et al. Urban network analytics has become an essential tool for understanding and modeling the structure and complexity of cities. We introduce the Urbanity data repository to nurture this growing research field, offering an open spatial network resource spanning 50 major cities in 29 countries worldwide. Coverage: global; published in 2023. Formats: GeoJSON, Python. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 17811583986 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
